name: verify_joint_arrival
summary: Separate joint command acceptance/completion from measured arrival with explicit tolerance evidence.

generality.rationale: Applies to any Kinex joint device and any joint-space Servo target without task or object assumptions.
assumptions: The joint device reports measured positions in the same order and units as the command.
limitations: Does not verify Cartesian pose, physical contact, visual effect, or task success.

level.rationale: One live read plus a deterministic per-joint tolerance comparison.

composition.strategy: Read measured positions once and compare them with the executed target.

provenance.failure_gap: Execution receipts showed accepted/completed but not reached, causing failure analysis to misread the planned retreat as a failed press arrival.
evidence: harness_v2_iter_003 produced four completed Servo calls with reached=null
failure analysis compared the final retreat state against the press stage and inferred a false controller failure
